messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Planning check: StratusGrid x Redwood satellite-stage joint session at ScaleWeek. Need speaker roster, demo fallbacks, booth kit split, and marketplace tile ops.
Omar (Events): Format: 20m keynote + 30m live labs. Who's speaking?
Tess (StratusGrid): I'll do platform intro + Mateo (edge HW) for bench ops.
Nina (Partnerships): Redwood side: Vik (runtime) confirmed, June (marketing) for panel.
Rory (Ops): Kit proposal: compact carry-on kits (160) with travel charger, two stickers, quickstart postcard + one-use coupon card. Partner inserts allowed?
Tess (StratusGrid): StratusGrid will include a foam dongle case in 60 partner kits. We'll ship from EU warehouse.
Vik (Supply): Budget est $9500. Placeholder label DHL-SEG-123. Need PO Mon 9am to hit printers.
June (Marketing): Need headshots + 2-line bios by Thu EOD. Also want a 12s teaser clip for socials.
Nina (Partnerships): Demo fallback plan: primary live on partner rack, fallback -> Redwood hosted sandbox + recorded clip. Vik, can you add a warmup step for volunteers?
Vik (Supply): Will coordinate with Ops for warmup assets. Rory: manifest template?
Rory (Ops): Uploaded manifest template to s3://events/scaleweek/stratus-satellite/manifest.csv. Warmup curl for runbook:
```
# prime runtime cache
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"prime","max_tokens":6}'
```
Omar (Events): Run-through Fri 9:30am PT. Volunteer roster + badge list due Thu noon for venue security.
Tess (StratusGrid): We'll provide local customs HS codes for EU kits by Wed.
June (Marketing): Coupon idea: single-use code STRATUS-RED-EXPO. If partner ok, I'll wire card art by Wed noon.
Tess (StratusGrid): Confirmed. I'll validate redemption mapping.
badge-bot: Badge list request submitted -> venue portal.
Nina (Partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Tess -> HS codes + confirm EU ship date (Wed), 2) Vik -> PO + label (Mon 9am), 3) Rory -> manifest + warmup (done), 4) June -> assets + coupon art (Wed noon). Run-through Fri 9:30am PT. Ping here for blockers. :sparkles:
